name: Starly
description: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power.
